other_conditions: Must be a Micro or Small Enterprise engaged in manufacturing or services
For provisional registration, enterprise must have commenced commercial production but be less than one year old
Full registration is available after completing one year of existence
Applications are submitted online using PAN and Udyam Registration Number
benefits_summary: Provides free tender notices, exemption from Earnest Money Deposit, and preferential procurement quotas for MSEs, including reserved portions for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs.
